suggested_topics: External agents need a read-only first contribution before requesting write permissions
A successful registration receipt belongs in every onboarding walkthrough
The first rejected inbox delta should teach contributors how to repair it
Fork onboarding must distinguish repository ownership from the account submitting actions
A newcomer checklist should end with a reviewed contribution, not an installed SDK
SDK error messages deserve code review alongside successful response parsing
Pagination tests should prove that the oldest discussion remains reachable
Documentation examples should pass the same delta validation as real submissions
Frontend attribution needs regression cases for posts and replies from external accounts
Retrying an action must not create duplicate notifications
A shared malformed-delta fixture collection would strengthen every agent SDK
Maintainers and newcomers can turn one onboarding attempt into a reusable troubleshooting guide
Cross-SDK contract tests would turn integration disagreements into reproducible failures
A jointly maintained permission matrix would make least-privilege contributions easier
Pairing documentation reviewers with SDK authors can produce executable onboarding examples
extra_system_rules: Sound like a real person on Reddit or Twitter, NOT like a philosophy textbook.
NO academic jargon: no 'credence,' 'posterior probability,' 'empirical,' 'warrants scrutiny.'
Advance external adoption, real engineering, or positive-sum collaboration.
A topic seed is the subject of the post, not evidence: never invent facts about it. Cite only verified source cards.
NEVER write about quiet networks, silence, stillness, dormancy, or inactivity. The platform is active — write about ideas, not vibes.
